ORCA · WEB + NATIVE iOS · 24 SEPTEMBER 2026

UI sweep fixes

Thirteen audit findings addressed across readability, document semantics, mobile layout, and native accessibility. Screenshots use synthetic demo/fixture mail.

Changes

FindingAreaChange
UI001Compose contrastUse the theme warning token for Open in Zen.
UI002Compose semanticsRender the dialog on a div instead of an aside.
UI003Later contrastUse theme-aware warning text on reminder badges.
UI004Signals copyRefer to the actual All Mail destination.
UI005Drafts landmarksKeep one named Drafts region.
UI006Settings landmarksGive Settings a main landmark; keep its workspace header outside sectioning elements.
UI007Calendar actionsReserve a development-only footer for Feedback so workspace controls remain reachable.
UI008Selected textDarken muted light-theme text for selected surfaces.
UI009Accent contrastDarken the light-theme accent for links and status labels.
UI010Reader layoutPlace Back and actions in document flow; keep replies clear of bottom navigation.
UI011Reader headingsRetain the day heading in the accessibility tree.
IOS001Saved reply titleRestore compose kind from the persisted draft context.
IOS002Accessibility textStack Inbox controls and Settings metadata/values at accessibility sizes; allow headings to wrap.

After screenshots

Manual follow-up

  1. At 390px width, open a thread, scroll to Reply, and confirm the fixed navigation never covers it.
  2. In light and dark themes, tab through Compose and Calendar controls; inspect focus, selected, and disabled labels.
  3. On iOS, save a reply, reopen it from Drafts, and confirm the title remains Reply.
  4. Set iOS text size to the largest accessibility setting, then inspect Inbox and Settings.

Physical-device keyboard, safe-area behavior, and VoiceOver remain useful release checks; this change was exercised in a browser and iPhone simulator.
